enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Shift legs. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping.

Open eyes. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on shower water. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wash body with soap. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body with towel. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread on counter. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Close cupboard. Pick up knife. Spread butter on bread. Pour milk into glass. Pick up glass. Drink milk. Pick up bread. Eat bread. Chew. Swallow. Place plate in sink. Wipe mouth. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Close wardrobe. Remove pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out stethoscope. Place stethoscope in bag. Pick up bag. Zip bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close car door. Fasten seatbelt. Insert key. Start engine. Adjust rearview mirror. Press gas pedal. Drive. Stop at red light. Press gas pedal. Turn steering wheel. Arrive at hospital. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open car door. Step out. Close car door. Lock car. Walk to hospital entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, providing patient care and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Read chart. Walk to patient room. Knock on door. Open door. Greet patient. Wash hands. Check patient's vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Listen to heart. Administer medication. Record data. Update chart. Walk to next patient. Repeat care. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Wash hands. Walk to next patient.
Walk to cafeteria. Pick up tray. Choose food. Pay for food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Return tray. Walk out of cafeteria.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, continuing patient care and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nurse station. Pick up patient chart. Read chart. Walk to patient room. Knock. Enter. Check patient. Administer treatment. Record notes. Walk to computer. Type patient notes. Save file. Walk to next patient. Repeat. Attend meeting. Discuss cases. Walk to supply room. Restock. Walk to break room. Wash hands. Return to nurse station. Update charts. Walk to patient room. Discharge patient.

Walk to car. Unlock car. Open car door. Sit in driver's seat. Close door. Fasten seatbelt. Start engine. Adjust mirror. Drive. Stop at red light. Press gas. Turn. Arrive home. Park car. Turn off engine. Unfasten seatbelt. Open door. Step out. Close door. Lock car. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing hands and freshening up after work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Pick up towel. Dry hands. Wipe face. Turn off light. Walk out.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Place vegetables on cutting board. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on induction cooker. Place pan on cooker. Pour oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add spices. Turn off cooker. Pick up plate. Serve food. Walk to table. Sit down. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Stand up. Place plate in sink. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Type. Browse internet. Close laptop. Put down laptop. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out water. Close refrigerator. Drink water. Walk back to living room. Sit on couch. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and completing evening hygiene routine
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step in. Wash body. Rinse. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Apply moisturizer. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, reading on the phone before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Turn on bedside lamp. Lie down on bed. Pick up phone. Open reading app. Read. Scroll. Turn off phone. Put down phone. Turn off lamp. Close eyes. Breathe slowly.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Place head on pillow. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Shift legs. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Continue sleeping.
